method: Exact text after outer trimming and whitespace folding only. No case folding, numeric conversion, aliasing, or Unicode correction. Row association uses source-page geometry, not recognized text.
validationScope: Development corpus, not unseen real-world or independent supplier validation.

secondaryAccuracy.definition: Remove whitespace only from expected and extracted item names and raw values, after the same geometry-only row association. No Unicode, case, punctuation, digit, fuzzy, or alias correction. Production values remain unchanged.

review.correctionDefinition: Mismatched target cells across one metadata set per expected certificate and six cells per expected row; counts absent expected values, does not count extra rows or boundary-review operations. This is not measured user correction effort.
